review: PR810 problem2307042 sealed preprint package round 1

issues.finding: The public verification archive contains preprint/build_package.py but does not contain preprint/supplement_selection.json. main() unconditionally reads this absent dependency before doing any work, so the packaged assembly program cannot be run from a clean public extraction. The selected list is a sealed preparation input but is omitted by PUBLIC and not separately delivered by the upload kit.
issues.evidence: BUILD_ASSEMBLY_FAILURE.txt gives FileNotFoundError for extracted/preprint/supplement_selection.json. In a disposable copy, restoring only this selection file and the separately supplied PDF makes build_package.py reproduce the currently sealed verification.zip byte-for-byte (ASSEMBLY_DEPENDENCY_PROBE.json).
issues.specific_fix: Include supplement_selection.json in PUBLIC and the authored archive manifest, keep its chosen entries confined to delivered authored inputs, document the public extraction layout and assembly command, and rebuild/reseal verification.zip, deposit and upload kit. Preserve the immutable historical source archives.

issues.finding: The documented Tectonic command assumes output/pdf already exists. That directory is absent from the public verification archive, and the separately uploaded PDF has another top-level name. A clean reader following the documented command gets an output-directory error.
issues.evidence: tex_build_probe/build_stderr.txt: output directory output/pdf does not exist. After mkdir -p output/pdf, an isolated cached rebuild succeeds, has five pages, and its extracted layout text equals the sealed PDF text.
issues.specific_fix: Add mkdir -p output/pdf before the compile command, state that commands run inside the extracted preprint folder, and document where the separately supplied PDF belongs if rebuilding the upload kit. Rebuild the changed README into the supplement and kit.

issues.finding: README calls the research note four-page, but the sealed output is five pages; the two final bibliography entries occupy page 5.
issues.evidence: pdfinfo and visual inspection of all five pages, plus isolated rebuild yielding five pages.
issues.specific_fix: Remove the hard-coded page count or say five-page; alternatively revise pagination while preserving readable formulas, then inspect/reseal the resulting PDF and update all descriptions consistently.
